dep.name: citty
dep.purpose: Declarative CLI command tree (commands, subcommands, typed args, help).

dep.name: fast-xml-parser
dep.purpose: Strict structural XML parsing and well-formedness validation (ADR-2).

dep.name: yaml
dep.purpose: Parse and validate cordis.patch.yml before and after installer edits (ADR-7).

dep.name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
dep.purpose: MCP stdio server transport and protocol schemas.

dep.name: typescript
dep.purpose: Development-only: strict typecheck (tsc --noEmit); not shipped at runtime.

dep.name: @types/node
dep.purpose: Development-only: Node type definitions for tsc.

constraint.reason: Bun is the packaged runtime; engines field and pack-smoke enforce it.
Node native type stripping target documented by ADR-7.
Structural parser API used by grace-xml; no regex XML fallback.

module-level.focus: Fast deterministic unit and contract checks per module; one negative test per detector class.

wave-level.focus: Integration surfaces touched by a wave: MCP stdio, trust model, path safety.

phase-level.focus: Full gate: strict typecheck, bun test, demo lint --strict, docs validators, pack-smoke.

Testing.mocking-policy: Prefer fakes and temp directories over broad monkey-patching; real filesystem temp projects are used for CLI behaviour.

Observability.log-format: Findings carry stable codes and file/line locations; text mode is a compact human digest.
Observability.required-fields: ok, exitCode, findings, meta; each finding: severity, code, message, file, line, hint
Observability.redaction: Never log secrets or environment dumps; doctor prints only tool versions and paths.

DeliveryShape.shape: One npm package (@osovv/mygrace-cli) with all runtime sources and a bun shebang; optional DeepSeek Harness bundle, skills and status panel are published separately.
MCP server runs over stdio and launches the CLI through the absolute runtime path (no PATH dependency).
Release gate: pack-smoke on a fresh temp dir plus the full CI suite; semver policy and honest CHANGELOG.
